WITH aug AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(i.line_total) AS amount, SUM(i.quantity) AS boxes FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN purchase_order_items AS i ON i.po_id = po.id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE po.submitted_at >= '2026-08-01' AND po.submitted_at < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY p.category), sep AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(i.line_total) AS amount, SUM(i.quantity) AS boxes FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN purchase_order_items AS i ON i.po_id = po.id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE po.submitted_at >= '2026-09-01' AND po.submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT COALESCE(a.category, s.category) AS category, a.amount AS aug_amount, a.boxes AS aug_boxes, s.amount AS sep_amount, s.boxes AS sep_boxes FROM aug AS a FULL OUTER JOIN sep AS s ON a.category = s.category ORDER BY category LIMIT 100

WITH f AS (SELECT rf.sku, rf.metric_key, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS val, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.period_start >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30' AND rf.metric_key IN ('stock_on_hand', 'units_sold') GROUP BY rf.sku, rf.metric_key) SELECT p.sku, p.product_name_en, MAX(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' THEN f.val END) AS ending_stock, MAX(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'units_sold' THEN f.val END) AS units_sold FROM f LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.sku = f.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name_en ORDER BY p.sku LIMIT 100

WITH inv AS (SELECT rf.sku, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS stock FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' AND rf.period_end >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY rf.sku), sold AS (SELECT rf.sku, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS units FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'units_sold' AND rf.period_end >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY rf.sku) SELECT p.sku, p.product_name_en, inv.stock AS ending_stock, sold.units AS units_sold, CASE WHEN sold.units > 0 THEN inv.stock / sold.units * 30 END AS days_of_supply FROM inv JOIN sold ON sold.sku = inv.sku LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.sku = inv.sku ORDER BY p.sku LIMIT 100

WITH periods AS (SELECT DISTINCT period_start, period_end FROM report_facts WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND metric_key = 'revenue' AND NOT period_start IS NULL ORDER BY period_start DESC LIMIT 2), agg AS (SELECT f.period_start, f.period_end, SUM(f.numeric_value) AS confirmed_revenue, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS f JOIN periods AS p ON f.period_start = p.period_start AND f.period_end = p.period_end WHERE f.status = 'confirmed' AND f.metric_key = 'revenue' GROUP BY f.period_start, f.period_end) SELECT period_start, period_end, confirmed_revenue, fact_count FROM agg ORDER BY period_start DESC
